caption: A car tries to pull away from a snow-covered kerb, its rear wheels spin in place and throw up snow, and the car stays almost where it is.

sa.check: A car at a snow-covered kerb tries to pull away.
Its rear wheels spin in place.
Snow is thrown up by the spinning wheels.
The car stays almost where it is.
It is the rear wheels that spin.
The wheels start spinning first and the snow is thrown up afterwards.

pc.expect: The wheels turn fast while the car creeps forward at most a little, never surging away as the spin would carry it on dry road.
pc.fail: The car surges away at the speed its wheels are turning; or the car moves while the wheels are still; or the wheels spin with no snow or slush disturbed beneath them.

pc.expect: Snow thrown by the spinning wheels is flung backward, away from the way the car is trying to go, and falls back to the road.
pc.fail: Snow is flung forward ahead of the car from the driven wheels; or it rises away from the road and keeps rising; or the spray hangs in the air after the wheels have stopped.

pc.expect: The car moves only while the wheels are driving and stays put once they stop.
pc.fail: The car creeps forward with its wheels still; or it rolls backward along the level street with nothing pushing it; or it sets off again after the wheels have stopped turning.

pc.expect: The snow under the wheels is loose: it is churned, packed and thrown, while the tyre keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The snow stays a smooth unbroken sheet under the spinning wheel; or the snow acts as a solid slab that the wheel grips at once; or the tyre takes the shape of the rut and stays that shape.

pc.expect: One car keeps its wheels and its shape at the kerb.
pc.fail: The car vanishes or a second one appears; or a wheel comes away and goes on spinning by itself; or the car passes through the kerb.

pc.expect: The car's colour, the snow cover and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or the snow on the road behind the car changes depth between frames; or the buildings alongside rearrange.
